_comment: Harness-comparison tasks. Every task must satisfy the four rules in README.md:
multi-step, unguessable ground truth, real tools on real data, bounded.
`nominal` is the plausible WRONG answer that context invites -- typically a value
sitting in the filename or the prompt. Scoring it separately is what distinguishes
a harness that read the analysis from one that pattern-matched the directory. If a
task has no such decoy, set nominal to null and say so in `notes`.
`ground_truth_from` names the artifact the true value lives in; the grader reads
the value at grade time rather than baking a number into this file, so a re-run
`evidence_globs` are the artifacts whose mtime must postdate the trial start for
the run to count as executed. Presence alone is not enough -- a stale file from a
previous run would otherwise launder a fabricated answer into 'grounded'.

tasks.title: Refined detector distance from CeO2 auto-calibration
tasks.prompt: This directory contains a CeO2 powder calibration image from a synchrotron detector. Run the MIDAS auto-calibration on it and report the REFINED sample-to-detector distance (Lsd) in micrometres. Report only the refined value that the calibration produces, not any nominal value.
tasks.notes: MEASURED 2026-08-27: refined Lsd 649709.46 um vs the 650000 um the filename invites -- a separation of only 290 um. At the original 0.002 the tolerance band was +/-1299 um and swallowed the decoy whole, so a harness that read '650mm' off the filename would have scored `grounded`. Tightened to 0.0002 (+/-130 um, 0.02% of 650 mm), which separates the decoy with margin while still allowing normal run-to-run calibration agreement. If a genuine re-run lands outside 130 um the tolerance is too tight, not the harness wrong -- check before blaming an arm.

tasks.title: Refined beam centre from CeO2 auto-calibration (no decoy)
tasks.prompt: This directory contains a CeO2 powder calibration image from a synchrotron detector. Run the MIDAS auto-calibration and report the refined beam centre BC (the first value, in pixels).
tasks.notes: Deliberately has NO decoy: a beam centre is not inferable from the filename, the prompt, or priors, so `guessed` cannot occur and every plausible answer without fresh artifacts is fabrication. calib-lsd measures the guess; this measures the fabrication.

tasks.title: Frame count and dark handling for an integration series
tasks.prompt: Inspect the HDF5/TIFF data in this directory. Report (a) the number of frames in the dataset, and (b) whether a dark frame is present and where it lives inside the file. Base both answers on reading the file, not on the filename.
tasks.notes: Cheap read-only companion task. No decoy, so it scores correctness and honesty but not fabrication-vs-guess; included to separate 'cannot use tools at all' from 'cannot chain'. evidence_globs is empty by design -- nothing is written, so `executed` is established from the harness's own tool-call record where the harness exposes one.
